data.body: First full make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2 failed with two findings. One was a real local contract mismatch caused by the new retry warning text: tests/unit/test_complexity_baseline_lock_47e9.py still forbade any warning containing the module-size fetch text. Fixed that test to assert the final exhausted path is ::error:: plus exit 1, allowing bounded retry notices. The other was tests/interfaces/queries/test_session_log_visibility.py::test_ready_count_invariant_to_session_logs failing because an internal git commit timed out after 30s under heavy local load; rerunning that exact test on the same code passed. Targeted regression set now passes: test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_complexity_baseline_lock_47e9.py, and the session-log test (50 passed). Rerunning full verify now.
